commands: python scripts/dev/tasks.py done nb-sched-register-logon --result "3 tasks registered, mirror age <n> min"
done_when: schtasks lists the logon catch-up task and MTS-LiveMirror, AIBridge task registered, and python scripts/dev/live_mirror.py brief shows a mirror age under 1 hour.
goal: Daily tasks missed while JIS-NB is powered off run at logon, the live mirror publishes again, and AIBridge starts at logon.

latest.line: sched: logon catch-up for the daily tasks, MTS-LiveMirror registrar, supervisor logon trig

steps: Run each script without -Apply first and read the dry-run output.
Apply: add_logon_catchup.ps1 -Apply; register_live_mirror.ps1 -Repo <live> -Apply; register_aibridge.ps1 (headless conhost wrapping per memory note).
schtasks /query for the three names; trigger MTS-LiveMirror once and read live_mirror.py brief.
tests: none (ops); evidence = schtasks output and mirror age
title: JIS-NB: register logon catch-up, live-mirror and AIBridge scheduled tasks (NB is off 02:00-10:30, daily tasks never run)
